2609.28290.title: Computation Over Geometry: Meaning Identity Is Computed, Not Shipped in the Embeddings
2609.28290.paper_summary: Meaning identity (whether two sentences say the same thing after wording changes) is treated in retrieval and RAG as a geometric fact about independently encoded sentence vectors. We show that, for frozen off-the-shelf encoders and language models, it is not: identity is computed when both sentences share one forward pass, and is not a property of the embedding geometry those systems ship. On overlap-matched PAWS-X, purpose-built encoders (BGE, E5, GTE, MiniLM, E5-Mistral-7B) reach English confirm AUC only 0.55-0.65 (dense peak 0.70). Independently encoded last-token states of Llama 3, Mistral, and Qwen do no better; late fusion of the two vectors stays near chance. The same probe on a joint forward pass reaches 0.90-0.96 from 1.5B to 32B, collapses under partner shuffle, is mid-depth, saturates near 0.94 by 3B, and appears more weakly in GPT-2 XL (0.76). The gap holds beyond Llama-style models on other causal LMs, bidirectional encoders (DeBERTa, RoBERTa), and encoder-decoders (Flan-T5, T5, BART). Fixed or linear readers over frozen independent encodings never unlock identity; nonlinear pair readers recover part of it only on the full 49k-pair PAWS train split (0.68-0.87). Off-the-shelf rerankers split: BGE-reranker-large reaches 0.94, while MS-MARCO and Jina stay at 0.55-0.64. Independently trained families compute the same relation and a 1.5B joint reader can distill it from unlabelled teacher scores, while no linear function of the teachers own independent vectors can. Bi-encoders can be fine-tuned to fit PAWS (0.87-0.93), but transfer and STS-B suffer. Cosine compares wording neighbourhoods; identity is a cheap computed operator, not a property of either sentence vector.
2609.28290.paper_summary_zh: 意義身份（無論兩個句子在措辭變更後是否表達相同的內容）在檢索和RAG中被視為關於獨立編碼句子向量的幾何事實。<lb/>我們顯示，對於冷凍的現成編碼器和語言模型，這並非如此：當兩個句子共享一個前向傳遞時，身份是被計算出來的，並不是這些系統所提供的嵌入幾何的特性。<lb/>在重疊匹配的PAWS-X上，專門設計的編碼器（BGE、E5、GTE、MiniLM、E5-Mistral-7B）在英語確認AUC上僅達到0.55-0.65（密集峰值0.70）。<lb/>獨立編碼的Llama 3、Mistral和Qwen的最後一個標記狀態表現並不更好；兩個向量的晚期融合保持在隨機機會附近。<lb/>在一次聯合前向傳遞上，相同的探測達到0.90-0.96，從1.5B到32B，在合作夥伴洗牌下崩潰，處於中等深度，並在3B時接近飽和約0.94，並在GPT-2 XL中表現得更弱（0.76）。<lb/>這一差距在其他因果LM、雙向編碼器（DeBERTa、RoBERTa）和編碼-解碼器（Flan-T5、T5、BART）上超越了Llama風格模型。<lb/>固定或線性讀取器在冷凍的獨立編碼上從未解鎖身份；非線性對讀取器僅在完整的49k對PAWS訓練拆分上恢復部分身份（0.68-0.87）。<lb/>現成的重新排序器分裂：BGE-reranker-large達到0.94，而MS-MARCO和Jina保持在0.55-0.64。<lb/>獨立訓練的家族計算相同的關係，而1.5B的聯合讀取器可以從未標記的教師分數中提煉出來，而教師自己獨立向量的任何線性函數都無法做到。<lb/>雙編碼器可以微調以適應PAWS（0.87-0.93），但轉移和STS-B受到影響。<lb/>餘弦比較措辭鄰域；身份是一個廉價的計算運算符，而不是任一句子向量的特性。
2609.28290.author: Jiaqi Deng et.al.
